purpose: Implement one deterministic repository-side replay of the M9O canonical N1/N2/N3 definitions and the descriptive N6 H4-RCI risk layer against the supplied GOLD 2023-2026 files, without changing any live/forward system.

population.entry: first causal M1 turn after frozen M7C PRIMARY_LONG and before its frozen proxy LONG_EXIT

N1.selected_bar: latest M5 bar fully closed by first-turn decision time
N1.tick_volume_ratio20: selected tick_volume divided by arithmetic mean of selected plus previous 19 M5 tick_volume values
N1.condition: tick_volume_ratio20 <= empirical 50th percentile of latest 200 fully formed tick_volume_ratio20 values including selected

N2.selected_bar: latest M15 bar fully closed by first-turn decision time
N2.macd: EMA6(close)-EMA13(close), recursive alpha=2/(period+1), first close seed
N2.condition: macd_line_bps >= empirical 75th percentile of latest 200 closed-M15 macd_line_bps values including selected

N6_descriptive_only.selected_bar: latest H4 bar fully closed by first-turn decision time
N6_descriptive_only.rci: RCI9 Spearman rank correlation using average ranks for ties
N6_descriptive_only.condition: current H4 RCI9 empirical percentile over latest 100 closed H4 bars is >0.25 and <=0.50

forbidden: Do not modify M7C formula or thresholds.
Do not stop or reset M8C.
Do not use N6 as a historical gate or live stop.
Do not describe 2025 or 2026 as untouched validation.
Do not enable Discord send, MT5 orders, live ready, final signal or real trading entry gates.
